definitions.gloss: phone book; telephone directory; contacts list
definitions.explanation: A book or digital list containing telephone numbers and contact information. Can refer to either a printed telephone directory or the contacts list on a mobile phone.

examples.japanese: {電話帳|でんわちょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: I looked up the number in the phone book.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{電話帳|でんわちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}して→登録する：25227_tourokusuru⟧おく。
examples.english: I'll save it in my phone's contacts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{分厚|ぶあつ}い→分厚い：10502_buatsui⟧{電話帳|でんわちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦{見|み}かけない→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧。
examples.english: Every household used to have a thick phone book, but you hardly see them anymore.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧ (telephone) + ⟦{帳|ちょう}→帳：10012_chou⟧ (notebook, register). Traditionally referred to the printed telephone directory (like the Yellow Pages), but now more commonly refers to the contacts list on a smartphone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電話帳|でんわちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}っている→載る：27882_noru⟧: to be listed in the phone book
- {電話帳|でんわちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}する→登録する：25227_tourokusuru⟧: to register in one's contacts
- {電話帳|でんわちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧: to organize one's contacts

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{連絡先|れんらくさき}→連絡先：03191_renrakusaki⟧: contact information — more general, not limited to phone numbers
- ⟦{住所録|じゅうしょろく}→住所録：20471_juushoroku⟧: address book — includes physical addresses
- タウン⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧: Town Pages — Japan's yellow pages directory (brand name)
